newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes raid eastern Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes raid eastern Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes rocketed on Wednesday suspected Hizbollah targets in Lebanon's Syrian-controlled eastern Bekaa valley, security sources said.
Two planes fired a total of four rockets in two runs into hills in the southwestern part of the Bekaa, just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the sources said.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the raid, which was followed by heavy Israeli shelling of the area.
"Shelling is spreading into the outskirts of the town of Mashghara, coming increasingly closer to houses," a security source said.
The raid was the 39th by Israeli planes on Lebanon this year.

It followed two bomb explosions in the Israeli-occupied zone earlier on Wednesday in which a Lebanese civilian and a pro-Israeli Lebanese militiaman were killed and two civilians were wounded, according to pro-Israeli militia sources.
Moslem guerrillas fighting to drive Israeli and its local militia allies from the occupation zone frequently set off roadside bombs in the zone.
